evidence: Carries the Mining label and modifies block template construction and management in src/node/block_template_manager.cpp, src/interfaces/mining.h, and src/rpc/mining.cpp.
rationale: Adds transaction reference accounting to track memory held by stale templates and exposes getMemoryLoad() over the mining IPC interface. While essential visibility for external mining clients like sv2-tp and useful groundwork for memory caps, it only provides monitoring and does not yet enforce memory limits.
